reasons.plausibility: The proposed mechanism of low-temperature synthesis enhancing random mixing and electronic tuning in multi-element catalytic nanoparticles aligns well with established principles in alloy chemistry and catalysis.
reasons.testability: The straightforward comparison of low- versus high-temperature syntheses coupled with structural and catalytic characterization provides a clear experimental path to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis directly guides catalyst design strategies and offers a predictive approach for improving noble metal–based HEA nanocatalyst performance.
